lines: Hopeless, always fussing over the silliest things, getting worked up
Even we like that grew up
The ones who give me courage no matter what — everyone is the hope I speak of
They matter most, so they're the best friends I could have
I've made so many people cry — I never want to see my mother's tears again
Even someone like me, they never gave up on
Such wonderful people stayed by my side
Thank you (Don't lose your smile, don't forget your tears)
Thank you (To my favorite words, to the people dear to me)
Thank you (Don't lose your smile)
Thank you (Don't forget your tears)
Thank you (To my favorite words, to the people dear to me)
A small, small happiness is enough
May it keep going for us, forever...
Hopeless, always fussing over the silliest things, getting worked up
Even someone like me loved another
Always, for love's sake — every time those feelings grew stronger
We couldn't understand each other, and drifted apart
The hearts of those I made cry — I never want to see your tears again
Even someone like me, you loved
More than anything, I'm glad I could meet you
Those days (Without fear, live the present, live on strong)
That love (The words that saved me, still deep in my heart)
That person (Without fear, live the present)
What they gave me (Live on strong)
I won't forget (The words that saved me, still deep in my heart)
With nothing but a great, great love
We can surely become strong
